what.text: This page follows people displaced inside Libya, counted by IDMC and by UNHCR, shown side by side and never added together.
At the end of 2025, IDMC counted 85183 people living in internal displacement because of conflict and violence, and UNHCR counted 32791 internally displaced people of concern to it.
Refugees from Libya live mostly in the United Kingdom, Germany, France and Malta.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Libya in 2011, 2013 to 2015, 2017 and 2019 to 2020, with the Forces of the House of Representatives among the opponents.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group in Libya from 2015 to 2019, and floods are the disasters recorded for Libya in IDMC's data.

when.text: IDMC's figures rose from 154000 in 2011 to 500000 in 2015 and were lower by the end of 2025.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2014 to 2016 and 2019 to 2020, in the same years as these conflicts.

how.text: The sources don't say where displaced people are living or which routes they took.
IDMC also counts new displacements in each year, which count movements, not people, so someone forced to move twice is counted twice.
